# Inogen Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_4d14c67ee4d2d8db345c13197bc35e8e/inogen/news/2026-11-05_Inogen_Announces_Third_Quarter_2026_Financial_270.pdf) November 05, 2026


### Related Documents


[Audio](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=ZEfY0rqF)


[Earnings Webcast](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=ZEfY0rqF)


[Supplemental Financials](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_4d14c67ee4d2d8db345c13197bc35e8e/inogen/db/389/3953/supplemental_financials/Q326_Supplemental_Financials_Presentatio_v2.pdf)[PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_4d14c67ee4d2d8db345c13197bc35e8e/inogen/db/389/3953/supplemental_financials/Q326_Supplemental_Financials_Presentatio_v2.pdf)


*Board of Directors appoints Andy Reding as President and Chief Executive Officer*


*Company initiates a $20 million cost reduction program to accelerate profitability*


*Completes U.S. oxygen rental divestiture to simplify commercial model*


BEVERLY, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Inogen, Inc.](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/___http:/www.inogen.com___.YzJ1OmdpbG1hcnRpbmdyb3VwOmM6bzo4OTYyMTBjM2Q2MzU2YjlhMjM5Mzc1M2RkYzRjYWJmNjo2OjY1ZmU6MDdlMWNlZWU1OGJiM2Y5NTc5NGFmNGNkNzNhZGViNzU5NTljMTIzYzk4MmZiOGE0NGQwMTU2NmI1Yzg3ODIwNDpwOlQ6Rg) (Nasdaq:[INGN](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/___http:/www.inogen.com/investor___.YzJ1OmdpbG1hcnRpbmdyb3VwOmM6bzo4OTYyMTBjM2Q2MzU2YjlhMjM5Mzc1M2RkYzRjYWJmNjo2OjYyYWE6YTFkYmIzOGM1MmRmOTk5YWI4M2NiY2ExOTE3YjEzMDM0NmU4YTc0NmE1MmJlNDlkN2NlZGU3ZjE3NDdiNDM0MDpwOlQ6Rg) ), a medical technology company offering innovative respiratory products for use in the homecare setting, today announced financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.


“I am excited to lead Inogen at an important inflection in the Company’s evolution,” said Andy Reding, President and Chief Executive Officer. “We have a strong foundation, including a talented team, a differentiated portfolio of respiratory solutions, and deep customer relationships. At the same time, we have meaningful opportunities to sharpen our focus, strengthen execution, and improve commercial and operational performance. We remain focused on building a simpler, more focused company that can deliver sustainable, profitable growth and create long-term value for our shareholders.”


**Recent Business Highlights**


- Announced the appointment of Andy Reding as President and Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors
- Completed the divestiture of the U.S. oxygen rental business on November 2, 2026, for total estimated cash consideration of up to $24.8 million, sharpening the Company’s commercial focus and establishing a long-term supply agreement that expands patient access to Inogen’s oxygen concentrators through a national distribution network
- Initiated a cost reduction program beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026 that is expected to generate approximately $20 million of annualized savings by the end of 2027
- Delivered GAAP total revenue from continuing operations of $77.2 million in the third quarter of 2026, reflecting the divestiture of the U.S. oxygen rental business
- Reported GAAP loss from continuing operations of $14.8 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to $3.6 million in the prior-year period. Adjusted loss from continuing operations was $0.4 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to adjusted earnings of $1.2 million in the prior-year period
- Increased the Company’s existing share repurchase program authorization by $15 million bringing the total authorization to $45 million and further enhancing Inogen’s ability to return capital to shareholders
- Announced the Board of Directors’ intention to submit proposals at the 2027 Annual Meeting of Stockholders to declassify the Board, with all directors to be elected annually, and eliminating supermajority voting requirements in the Company’s Certificate of Incorporation and Bylaws


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results**


GAAP total revenue in the third quarter of 2026 was $77.2 million, a decrease of 2.4% from $79.1 million in the prior-year period, or a decrease of 3.2% on a constant currency basis. Revenue growth in the U.S. of 3.8%, was driven by demand for our portable oxygen concentrators, or POCs, and new products and was partially offset by capital softness in international markets.


GAAP gross margin was 44.1% in the third quarter of 2026 compared to 45.7% in the prior-year period. Adjusted gross margin was 44.2% in the third quarter of 2026 compared to 45.9% in the prior-year period due to a change in mix driven by lower international sales which more than offset continued cost of revenue improvements.


GAAP loss from continuing operations was $14.8 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to $3.6 million in the prior-year period. Adjusted loss from continuing operations was $0.4 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to adjusted earnings from continuing operations of $1.2 million in the prior-year period.


GAAP net loss per diluted share from continuing operations of $0.56 compared to $0.13 in the prior-year period. Adjusted net loss per diluted share from continuing operations was $0.02 in the third quarter of 2026 compared to adjusted net earnings per diluted share from continuing operations of $0.04 in the prior-year period.


Cash, cash equivalents, marketable securities, and restricted cash were $97.7 million as of September 30, 2026, with no debt outstanding. The Company repurchased 1,786,850 shares of common stock for $11.2 million year-to-date under the share repurchase program announced in the first quarter of 2026.


With the divestiture of the rental business, the Company has classified the results of that business as discontinued operations for all periods presented. Unless otherwise noted, financial results, non-GAAP measures, and guidance in this press release reflect continuing operations only, and prior period amounts have been recast to conform to the current presentation. Reconciliations of gross margin, operating expense, operating loss, net loss / earnings, and net loss / earnings per diluted share for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 are in the financial schedules that are a part of this press release. An explanation of these non-GAAP financial measures is also included below under the heading “Reconciliation of U.S. GAAP to Non-GAAP Financial Measures.”


**Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2026 Financial Outlook**


Due to the divestiture of the rental business, Inogen is now providing financial guidance from continuing operations. Inogen now expects fourth quarter 2026 revenue from continuing operations in the range of $65 million and $68 million.


For the full year 2026, Inogen now expects revenue from continuing operations in the range of $298 million and $301 million.


The Company expects an adjusted loss from continuing operations of $7 million to $8 million for full-year 2026.


The Company has not provided a reconciliation of forward-looking adjusted net loss to the most directly comparable GAAP measure because certain items that impact net loss are uncertain or outside the Company's control and cannot be reasonably predicted without unreasonable effort.


**Corporate Governance Update**


Inogen’s Board of Directors intends to submit proposals to stockholders at the Company’s 2027 Annual Meeting of Stockholders to (a) amend the Company’s Certificate of Incorporation to declassify the Board so that all directors are elected annually, and (b) eliminate the supermajority voting requirements in the Company’s Certificate of Incorporation and Bylaws. At the 2026 Annual Meeting on June 5, 2026, more than 99% of the votes cast for or against the Board’s declassification proposal were in favor. However, the proposal did not reach the affirmative vote of 66 2/3% of outstanding shares that the Company’s Certificate of Incorporation requires.

**About Inogen**


Inogen, Inc. (Nasdaq: INGN) is a leading global medical technology company offering innovative respiratory products for use in the homecare setting. Inogen supports patient respiratory care by developing, manufacturing, and marketing innovative best-in-class respiratory therapy devices used to deliver care to patients suffering from chronic respiratory conditions. Inogen partners with patients, prescribers, home medical equipment providers, and distributors to make its respiratory therapy products widely available, allowing patients the chance to manage the impact of their disease.


For more information, please visit[www.inogen.com](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/___http:/www.inogen.com___.YzJ1OmdpbG1hcnRpbmdyb3VwOmM6bzo4OTYyMTBjM2Q2MzU2YjlhMjM5Mzc1M2RkYzRjYWJmNjo2OjY1ZmU6MDdlMWNlZWU1OGJiM2Y5NTc5NGFmNGNkNzNhZGViNzU5NTljMTIzYzk4MmZiOGE0NGQwMTU2NmI1Yzg3ODIwNDpwOlQ6Rg) .

**Non-GAAP Financial Measures**


Inogen has presented certain financial information in accordance with U.S. GAAP and also on a non-GAAP basis for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, and September 30, 2025. Management believes that these non-GAAP financial measures, taken in conjunction with U.S. GAAP financial measures, provide useful information for both management and investors by excluding certain non-cash and other expenses that are not indicative of Inogen’s core operating results. Management uses these non-GAAP measures to compare Inogen’s performance relative to forecasts and strategic plans, to benchmark Inogen’s performance externally against competitors, and for certain compensation decisions. Non-GAAP information is not prepared under a comprehensive set of accounting rules and should only be used to supplement an understanding of Inogen's operating results as reported under U.S. GAAP. Inogen encourages investors to carefully consider its results under U.S. GAAP, as well as its supplemental non-GAAP information and the reconciliation between these presentations, to more fully understand its business. Reconciliations between U.S. GAAP and non-GAAP results are presented in the accompanying tables of this release.
